tools.name: calculate_grade
tools.description: Converts a numerical percentage score to a letter grade using standard grading scale (A, B, C, D, F). (cost: 1 credit)

tools.name: is_leap_year
tools.description: Checks if a given year is a leap year using the Gregorian calendar rule (divisible by 4, except centuries unless divisible by 400). (cost: 1 credit)

tools.name: calculate_gpa
tools.description: Calculates the Grade Point Average (GPA) from a list of grade points on a 4.0 scale. Returns the mean of all grades rounded to 2 decimal places. (cost: 1 credit)

tools.name: batting_average
tools.description: Calculates a baseball player's batting average by dividing hits by at-bats. Returns the result rounded to the specified precision (default 3 decimal places). (cost: 1 credit)

tools.name: calculate_age
tools.description: Calculates a person's age in years based on their birth date and the current date. (cost: 1 credit)

tools.name: calculate_bmi
tools.description: Calculates Body Mass Index (BMI) using weight and height in either metric (kg, cm) or imperial (lbs, inches) systems. Formula: weight / (height²). (cost: 1 credit)

tools.name: calculate_tip
tools.description: Calculates the tip amount based on the bill total and tip percentage. Returns the tip amount and total including tip. (cost: 1 credit)

tools.name: calculate_calorie_intake
tools.description: Calculates recommended daily calorie intake using the Mifflin-St Jeor equation and macronutrient distribution based on personal characteristics and fitness goals. Returns total daily energy expenditure (TDEE) and grams of protein, carbohydrates, and fats. (cost: 1 credit)

tools.name: format_date
tools.description: Convert a date (and optional time) from one format to another using strftime codes (%Y %m %d %B %b %A %a %H %I %M %S %p %j). Rejects impossible dates such as 31 February instead of rolling them over. (cost: 1 credit)
